messages:
jordan: FYI customer 'Acme Corp' escalated. They pulled logs via API and say they see entries older than our 90d retention. They want a full export, timeline of any key rotations, and confirmation if data was preserved beyond retention. Need scope + customer-facing timeline by EOD.

nora: on it. what's the customer org id and the sample log ts they saw?

jordan: org=acme-corp (org_875). sample entry id: audit-20240102-9f3b. customer attached a JSON payload — says query returned entries from 2023-08.

sasha: tagging security. quick q — are they seeing raw audit entries or aggregated billing logs? If raw audit, risk is higher. Also, we rotated KMS keys for audit export on 2025-02-12, but HSM keys unchanged. I'll check access logs.

matt: infra here. I haven't seen any retention policy change. We did a reindex job (index-audit-v2) 2025-02-10 that backfilled metadata which could've made old events searchable even if flagged for purge. Running search now.

jordan: repro steps from support: used GET /v1/audit?org=acme-corp&start=2023-07-01&end=2024-02-01 with API key scoped to read:audit. We replicated locally and saw a couple of entries.

sasha: can you paste a sanitized log line? need to confirm PII not included before sharing.

jordan: pasted sanitized entry:
```json
{ \"id\": \"audit-20230115-xxxx\", \"org\": \"acme-corp\", \"event\": \"token.create\", \"ts\": \"2023-01-15T12:34:56Z\" }
```

matt: I'm seeing the index backfill PR merged: GH#3421. The backfill job sets searchable=true on historical docs but relies on TTL sweeper to delete originals. Looks like sweeper had a high-failure window 2025-02-11 -> 2025-02-13 due to a node restart; some deletes might have been delayed.

sasha: that suggests a window where old docs remained searchable longer than intended but were scheduled for deletion. We need to verify whether any exports actually copied those docs to durable storage (S3/exports). Does customer request export of logs? If so, we must check export job logs and S3 objects access.

nora: customer explicitly asked for a "full export" of historical logs. I'll pause on promises until we have facts. I'll draft a response timeline: initial ack within 1 hour, update with scope within 8 hours, full findings within 48 hours. Legal signoff needed before any language about data exposure.

lee: legal — yes, don't promise exact retention recovery. If data may have been accessible, we should prepare notification templates and coordinate with SOC. Also check contract SLA on security incidents and notification windows.

incident-bot: Created incident INC-2025-8472 (severity: P2) and added teams: security, infra, support, legal.

matt: quick command to check export objects:
```bash
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-audit-exports/acme-corp/ --recursive | grep 2023
```
I ran a quick scan; no 2023 export files found for acme-corp.

sasha: pulling KMS/HSM audit: keyring=redwood-prod-keys, key=audits-export-key. Access log shows rotation activity 2025-02-12, but no unauthorized access. HSM logs show normal admin rotations.

jordan: next steps: 1) infra to confirm sweeper deletes for acme-corp (owner: matt, due 3h) 2) security to validate whether any export created or delivered (owner: sasha, due 6h) 3) support to draft customer-facing ack (owner: nora, due 1h) 4) legal to prepare notification template pending findings (owner: lee, due 6h).

nora: I'll send ack and set expectation: "we're investigating retention and export history; will follow up within 48 hours with details." will include incident id INC-2025-8472.

sasha: note — if we find that sweeper delayed deletes but no export occurred, classify as operational exposure window, not confirmed data leakage. We'll need to document root cause and mitigations.

lee: agreed. keep records of all queries/responses to customer. escalate to CISO if we find confirmed export.

jordan: thanks. keep updates in this thread and ping me for signoff before customer call.

matt: update — sweeper logs show delete queued for acme-corp docs on 2025-02-11 03:12 UTC but worker failed to confirm for 6 hours. I'll run a targeted sweep and post results.

jordan: ack — will update thread with final timeline when we have concrete confirmations.
